result.note: PAIN POINT: The regex [\w\s]+ in Python's re module includes underscore in \w. Spec says 'letters/digits/spaces only' (domain_spec.md line 95: 'Non-empty, letters/digits/spaces only'). This is a contradiction: Python regex \w matches underscore, but the human-readable description says 'letters/digits/spaces only'. The spec must clarify whether underscore is allowed. This simulation assumes the constraint is actual letters+digits+spaces (not Python \w) based on the plain-language description 'letters, digits, spaces' and the gherkin convention that 'Titles must contain ONLY Unicode letters, digits, and spaces — no hyphens, periods, underscores, or special characters'.
